- Created `scripts/rig-static-glbs-cli.mjs` — Node.js CLI that reads `GLB_ASSET_MANIFEST.json`, parses BANNON.glb/MAIME.glb geometry, attaches a 20-bone Mixamo-compatible skeleton (`mixamorigHips → mixamorigHead → L/R arms/legs`), computes inverse bind matrices from T-pose world positions, runs proximity-weighted skin binding (4 influences per vertex with smooth falloff), and writes `*_rigged_ready.glb` — run with `node scripts/rig-static-glbs-cli.mjs [--dry-run]`
- Created `src/components/PreCombatValidationScreen.tsx` — pre-combat screen that validates every active fighter against 7 strict checklist items (GLB registered, playable gate, skeleton bones > 0, skinned meshes > 0, animation clips > 0, no MISSING_CLIP verdicts, AnimationSourceRegistry completeness); blocks combat with color-coded PASS/WARN/BLOCKED status and explicit 5-step remediation guide; wired into App.tsx so Stage Select → Pre-Combat Validation → Combat
- Updated `BannonClipJsonAdapter.ts` with `loadBannonClipsFromDirectory()`, `loadBannonClipsFromUrls()`, and `loadBannonClipsFromPublic()` — loads actual `assets/moves/clips/*.json` motion data, normalizes Mixamo/FBX/BVH bone names to canonical skeleton, validates retarget resolution, and stamps each clip with `clipSourceType: 'AUTHORED_CLIP'`; `AnimationSourceRegistry` gains `registerAuthoredClips()` and `getClipSourceVerdicts()` for AUTHORED_CLIP/PLACEHOLDER_TEST_CLIP/MISSING_CLIP verdicts; `CharacterPipeline` now calls `loadBannonClipsFromPublic()` before falling back to procedural placeholders"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/d6674e4361ab9b86a367770611c254628c20ab18","sha":"d6674e4361ab9b86a367770611c254628c20ab18"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:31:04Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:31:04Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T17:30:59.726Z
- Added end-to-end instrumentation logging across the full pipeline: `MobileControls` now logs every non-trivial input event (`[MobileControls] 🎮 INPUT → [LP(1) | LIGHT]`); `FighterStateMachine.beginAttack()` logs every state transition with move details (`[FSM] ⚔️ STATE TRANSITION: "idle" → "lightAttack" startup=0.120s active=0.100s`); `FighterMesh.resolveClipName()` logs the full `combatState → semantic → clip` resolution chain with `MISSING_CLIP` warnings when no match is found
- Connected all combat state transitions in `FighterMesh` to `AnimationBridge.getClipForCombatState()` — `resolveClipName` now uses `COMBAT_STATE_TO_SEMANTIC` as the authoritative first lookup step, mapping `lightAttack → attack_1`, `Knockdown → knockdown`, `WakeupQuickStand → getup`, `BlockHit/StunBlocked → block`, `CommandThrow → grapple`, etc., with console logging of every resolution and explicit `MISSING_CLIP` warnings
- Updated `AnimationIntegrityGate` with four clip source types (`AUTHORED_CLIP`, `RETARGETED_AUTHORED_CLIP`, `PLACEHOLDER_TEST_CLIP`, `MISSING_CLIP`) and four verdicts (`PASS` = real authored/retargeted deformation, `TEST_ONLY` = placeholder drives mixer but statues are NOT fixed, `BLOCKED` = no usable animation, `UNKNOWN` = insufficient evidence); added `classifyClipSource()` utility and per-clip source summary in every report
- Created `src/components/AnimationTestArena.tsx` — a full moveset creation scene with fighter select panel, 3D viewport with orbit controls, semantic state cycling through all 12 states (`idle, walk_forward, attack_1, block, hit_reaction, knockdown, getup, grapple…`), auto-cycle with configurable speed, clip source badge (color-coded AUTHORED/RETARGETED/PLACEHOLDER/MISSING), and live integrity gate panel showing bone travel, track resolution, and verdict
- Added `ANIM TEST` entry to the main menu in `App.tsx` routing to the new `AnimationTestArena` screen"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/e65ec1c4c7982674a35cae35bb551df62d29763d","sha":"e65ec1c4c7982674a35cae35bb551df62d29763d"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:23:09Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:23:09Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T17:23:05.936Z
- Created `src/engine/retarget/BannonClipJsonAdapter.ts` — converts Bannon motion bank JSON (per-bone quaternion/position frames) into real `THREE.AnimationClip` objects with `QuaternionKeyframeTrack`/`VectorKeyframeTrack`; normalizes Mixamo/FBX/BVH/Bannon bone names to canonical skeleton names; generates labeled `PROCEDURAL_PLACEHOLDER` clips (idle breathing, walk leg-swing, attack arm-punch) when no authored clips exist so the pipeline is verifiable end-to-end
- Created `src/engine/retarget/AnimationSourceRegistry.ts` — catalogs animation sources by type (`BANNON_MOTION_BANK`, `BANNON_RIG_REFERENCE`, `SCHWARZERBLITZ`, `NIGHTSKY_ENGINE`, `TEKKEN_TOOLING`, `OPEN_MOCAP`, `PROCEDURAL`) with priority, provenance, and license; validates registry completeness against required semantic states; reports `PASS`/`PARTIAL`/`BLOCKED`
- Created `src/engine/retarget/SemanticStateAliases.ts` — shared `SEMANTIC_STATE_ALIASES` and `COMBAT_STATE_TO_SEMANTIC` tables (breaking the circular import between `CharacterPipeline` ↔ `animation_bridge/retarget`); maps every `FighterStateMachine` state (`lightAttack`, `Knockdown`, `WakeupQuickStand`, etc.) to its semantic animation state (`attack_1`, `knockdown`, `getup`)
- Updated `src/engine/pipeline/CharacterPipeline.ts` — `extractAndRetargetAnimations` now: (1) registers GLB clips in `AnimationSourceRegistry` with semantic state tagging, (2) generates `PROCEDURAL_PLACEHOLDER` clips via `BannonClipJsonAdapter` when GLB has zero animations so the mixer always has something to drive, (3) validates registry completeness and logs `PASS`/`PARTIAL`/`BLOCKED` per fighter before combat
- Updated `animation_bridge/retarget.ts` — imports `SEMANTIC_STATE_ALIASES`/`COMBAT_STATE_TO_SEMANTIC` from shared module; adds `AnimationBridge.resolveSemanticState()` and `AnimationBridge.getClipForCombatState()` static methods for state-machine-driven clip lookup with fallback chains
- Updated `src/components/FighterMesh.tsx` — `resolveClipName` now uses `COMBAT_STATE_TO_SEMANTIC` as the first lookup step so combat state transitions (`lightAttack` → `attack_1`, `Knockdown` → `knockdown`, etc.) drive the correct semantic clip including procedural placeholders"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/143e5960c90b3e5f2f135763837598d9aca44a67","sha":"143e5960c90b3e5f2f135763837598d9aca44a67"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:15:09Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:15:09Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T17:15:05.397Z
- Created `src/engine/retarget/AnimationRetargeter.ts` — deterministic retargeter mapping source bone names (Mixamo `mixamorigHips`, FBX `Bip001_Pelvis`, BVH `hip`, mocap, Schwarzerblitz) to 17 canonical Bannon skeleton bones (`Hips → Spine → Chest → Neck → Head → L/RUpperArm → L/RForeArm → L/RHand → L/RUpperLeg → L/RLowerLeg → L/RFoot`) via name-based resolution with 200+ aliases; logs full mapping table with `source bone | canonical bone | target bone | resolved/unresolved` per entry — no UUIDs used anywhere
- Created `src/engine/pipeline/RiggedGLBLoader.ts` — asset loader that classifies GLBs as `RIGGED_AND_ANIMATABLE / RIGGED_NO_ANIMATIONS / STATIC_MESH / ANIMATION_ONLY / MALFORMED`, prioritizes `BANNON_rigged.glb → BANNON_v1_rigready.glb` before falling back to static URLs, and routes `STATIC_MESH` entries to `OFFLINE_REPAIR_REQUIRED` with explicit console errors — never generates synthetic bones at runtime
- Updated `src/engine/pipeline/CharacterPipeline.ts` — added `extractAndRetargetAnimations()` that builds the retarget map from source→target skeleton, applies `AnimationRetargeter.retargetClips()`, runs `validateAnimationChannelBones()` before mixer starts, then feeds retargeted clips to `mixer.clipAction(cloned)` with instrumentation logging resolved/unresolved track counts, clip count, mixer root UUID, and retarget verdict
- Created `animation_bridge/retarget.ts` — `AnimationBridge` class wiring the source registry to Three.js runtime: `build()` retargets clips and maps them to 19 semantic states (`idle, walk_forward, walk_back, strafe_left, strafe_right, attack_1, attack_2, block, hit_reaction, knockdown, getup, grapple…`); reports `MISSING_CLIP` for any state with no valid clip; `feedToMixer()` calls `mixer.clipAction(clip, visibleClone)` on the correct visible clone
- Created `animation_bridge/SOURCE_REGISTRY.json` — canonical bone set + semantic state list; add permitted/open animation sources here with `id, file, semantic_state, source_convention, license, provenance` — proprietary Tekken bytes and non-redistributable Schwarzerblitz character assets explicitly excluded"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/18a4b8039803ad3aa18bf10cef19babe78452852","sha":"18a4b8039803ad3aa18bf10cef19babe78452852"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:06:48Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T17:06:48Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T17:06:44.684Z
- Fixed `VFXOverlay` arc() crash by clamping `alpha = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife))` — prevents `(1 - alpha)` going negative when `p.life > p.maxLife` on spawn-frame delta overshoot
- Fixed `MobileControls` `buffer.drain is not a function` crash at line 84 by adding `typeof buffer.drain === 'function'` guard before calling drain in the rAF loop
- Created `tools/diagnostics/inspect-glb-assets.mjs` — deterministic offline GLB inspector using `@gltf-transform/core` that classifies each asset as `RIGGED_AND_ANIMATABLE` / `RIGGED_NO_ANIMATIONS` / `STATIC_MESH` / `ANIMATION_ONLY` / `MALFORMED`, reports SHA256, bone names, animation clips, channel resolution, and canonical Bannon bone coverage; outputs `docs/GLB_ASSET_MANIFEST.json`
- Created `tools/bannon/find-bannon-animation-sources.mjs` — recursively searches the Bannon repo and connected repos for real animation sources (FBX, BVH, animated GLBs, mocap tools, `BANNON_rigged.glb`), outputs pipeline recommendation to `docs/BANNON_ANIMATION_SOURCES.json`
- Created `src/engine/combat/AnimationIntegrityGate.ts` — per-fighter pre-combat report producing `PASS` / `BLOCKED` / `UNKNOWN` verdict with: VISIBLE MESHES, SKINNED MESHES, SKELETON BONES, ANIMATION CLIPS, TRACKS, RESOLVED/UNRESOLVED TRACKS, ACTIVE CLIP, MIXER ROOT validation, and measured BONE TRAVEL over a synthetic 1/60s tick (reversed after measurement); `UNKNOWN` is never `PASS`
- Wired `AnimationIntegrityGate` into `FighterMesh.tsx` — fires on first combat-active state entry, exposes `onAnimationIntegrityReport` callback prop so `CombatArena3D`/`GameBattleArena` can display the report
- Updated `AGENTS.md` with Animation Pipeline Law v11: correct pipeline diagram, forbidden-actions table, asset classification table, integrity gate format, and **corrected Authored Skeleton Law** explicitly prohibiting `buildSyntheticRig()` and all runtime bone/weight generation
- Added npm scripts: `glb:inspect`, `glb:inspect:verbose`, `bannon:find-anim-sources`

**Critical finding documented**: `BANNON.glb` and `MAIME.glb` are `STATIC_MESH` assets — they have no `JOINTS_0`/`WEIGHTS_0`/skeleton. The runtime correctly identifies this. The fix is **not** synthetic rigging — it is locating `BANNON_rigged.glb` / `BANNON_v1_rigready.glb` from the Bannon repository (`assets/models/incoming/`) and copying them to `public/models/`. Run `npm run bannon:find-anim-sources` to inventory what animation sources exist, then `npm run glb:inspect` to classify every GLB. The authored rig must exist as a real file before animation can work."},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/c4ccadb52c723de44af4c57194082b34a1ce8c10","sha":"c4ccadb52c723de44af4c57194082b34a1ce8c10"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:57:17Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:57:17Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:57:13.694Z
- Fixed `IndexSizeError` in `VFXOverlay` — wrapped all `canvas.arc()` and `createRadialGradient()` radius arguments with `Math.max(0, ...)` / `Math.max(0.001, ...)` guards in `CombatArena3D.tsx` for both legacy particles and the 3-layer hit effect corona/core draws, preventing negative radii from ever reaching the Canvas API"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/63b4958f991524f6a3b76d42e1985c7a664278b1","sha":"63b4958f991524f6a3b76d42e1985c7a664278b1"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:49:31Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:49:31Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:49:27.698Z
- Added `validateAnimationChannelBones()` to `CharacterPipeline.ts` — runs before the mixer starts, checks every animation clip track resolves to a real bone in the cloned skeleton, and logs `❌ BONE MISMATCH` errors with the exact target bone name and the full list of available bones when a channel can't resolve; called automatically in `runCharacterPipeline` between STEP 13 (mixer creation) and STEP 14 (clip loading)
- Created `tools/diagnostics/rig-static-glbs.mjs` — Node.js offline tool using `@gltf-transform/core` that reads `docs/GLB_MANIFEST.json`, finds every `STATIC_MESH` entry, and produces `*_rigged_placeholder.glb` files with a full 22-bone Mixamo-compatible humanoid skeleton (`Hips → Spine → Spine1 → Spine2 → arms/neck/head/legs`), `JOINTS_0`/`WEIGHTS_0` attributes via proximity-based inverse-distance weighting, and correct inverse bind matrices; outputs `docs/GLB_RIG_RESULTS.json`
- Added `glb:rig`, `glb:rig:dry`, `glb:rig:verbose` npm scripts to `package.json`; supports `--character BANNON` filter and `--output ./dir` override; run `npm run glb:scan` first to generate the manifest, then `npm run glb:rig:dry` to preview, then `npm run glb:rig` to write the placeholder rigs"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/0fd90d6da813784071c9afc5780375d79aa0694c","sha":"0fd90d6da813784071c9afc5780375d79aa0694c"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:37:44Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:37:44Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:37:40.712Z
- Created `tools/diagnostics/scan-roster-glbs.mjs` — Node.js diagnostic tool using `@gltf-transform/core` that scans all 24 roster GLBs, reports SkinnedMesh count, bone count, animation clip names, animation binding channel resolution, and classifies each character as `RIGGED_AND_ANIMATABLE` / `RIGGED_NO_ANIMATIONS` / `STATIC_MESH` / `ANIMATION_ONLY` / `MALFORMED`; outputs `docs/GLB_MANIFEST.json`
- Added `glb:scan`, `glb:scan:verbose`, `glb:scan:output` npm scripts to `package.json` for easy agent invocation
- Added **GLB Diagnostic Manifest** section to `AGENTS.md` documenting the tool contract, how agents should read the manifest to diagnose statue/bind-pose lock root causes, and the `animationBindingDiagnostic` field that directly identifies whether animation channels resolve to real bones (the most common statue cause)

**To run the scan now:**
```bash
npm run glb:scan           # outputs docs/GLB_MANIFEST.json
npm run glb:scan:verbose   # + per-file detail in console
```

The manifest's `animationBindingDiagnostic.bindingStatus` field is the key statue diagnostic:
- `NO_CHANNELS_RESOLVED` → animation tracks target wrong bone names → retarget mismatch → fix the asset or add name-based retargeting in `CharacterPipeline.ts`
- `ALL_CHANNELS_RESOLVED` but still frozen → mixer targeting wrong object → see LAW 1 in `AGENTS.md`
- `STATIC_MESH` classification → no skeleton in the GLB at all → offline Blender/Mixamo rigging required, no runtime fix possible"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/0e4aebc1811f38772343f7ed37f1fa6c05bbf3c1","sha":"0e4aebc1811f38772343f7ed37f1fa6c05bbf3c1"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:33:03Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:33:03Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:33:00.717Z
- Fixed `IndexSizeError` in `VFXOverlay` — clamped `coreRadius` and `coronaRadius` to `Math.max(0, ...)` in `HitEffectSystem.ts` so a negative `scale` value can never produce a negative radius passed to `canvas.arc()`"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/66919515e0b4257eb6dfc00a4905ad0d8aa5d3da","sha":"66919515e0b4257eb6dfc00a4905ad0d8aa5d3da"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:31:06Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:31:06Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:31:01.774Z
- Fixed **statue/bind-pose lock**: `FIRST_FRAME_DISPLACEMENT` in `DeformationIntegrityLogger.ts` now skips `mixer.stopAllAction()` for static-mesh GLBs (no SkinnedMesh with skeleton) — the mixer is only stopped when a real rigged mesh is present, preventing the idle animation from being killed with no recovery path
- Fixed **mixer recovery logic** in `FighterMesh.tsx`: after the integrity test, recovery now detects whether the mixer was actually stopped (by checking if any action is still running) before attempting restart — static-mesh GLBs keep their idle animation uninterrupted; rigged GLBs recover correctly
- Removed **`normalizeSkinWeights()`** from `CharacterPipeline.ts` per directive — authored skin weights are no longer mutated at runtime; also rewrote `useInputBuffer.ts` with a simpler plain-array queue (replacing the ring-buffer) to permanently fix `buffer.drain is not a function` and `buffer.push is not a function` crashes in `MobileControls`"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/223de78a42dc80118035f2fbe812865e16287ef1","sha":"223de78a42dc80118035f2fbe812865e16287ef1"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:27:41Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:27:41Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:27:38.364Z
- Fixed bind pose lock in `FighterMesh.tsx` — the 14-point deformation integrity test was permanently setting `deformationPassedRef.current = false` when checks like `SKELETON_EXISTS` / `SKINNED_MESH_SKELETON` failed (valid GLBs without standard Three.js bone types), blocking all animation playback forever
- Made integrity test diagnostic-only — it now logs warnings but never blocks animation; `onDeformationBlocked` only fires for truly unrenderable assets (`NO_VISIBLE_MESH`); `deformationPassedRef` is always reset to `true` after the test
- Added guaranteed mixer recovery after every integrity test run — `FIRST_FRAME_DISPLACEMENT` calls `mixer.stopAllAction()` + `setTime(0)`, so the fix always re-starts the correct clip (current state or idle fallback) immediately after the test regardless of verdict, preventing the statue/freeze state"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/00c75b1ff8d35bf41da97d116836510a9167ebee","sha":"00c75b1ff8d35bf41da97d116836510a9167ebee"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:15:38Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:15:38Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:15:34.986Z
- Fixed `useInputBuffer` — replaced `useMemo` with a `useRef`-based singleton pattern; the buffer object is now created once via lazy `if (bufferRef.current === null)` initialization, guaranteeing `push()` and `drain()` are always defined regardless of React Strict Mode double-invocations or render cycles
- Fixed `CharacterPipeline.validateAuthoredAsset` — `NO_VISIBLE_MESH` check now explicitly tests both `isMesh` and `isSkinnedMesh` flags, preventing false-positive BLOCKED status when a GLB's geometry is carried by `SkinnedMesh` objects (which extend `Mesh` but may not always satisfy `isMesh` alone across Three.js version quirks)"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/15836e84b20d21f2c7f84e34e1831c13fb63816a","sha":"15836e84b20d21f2c7f84e34e1831c13fb63816a"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:02:45Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T16:02:45Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T16:02:41.931Z
- Fixed `CharacterPipeline.validateAuthoredAsset` — downgraded `NO_SKINNED_MESH` and `NO_SKELETON` from hard blocks to console warnings; only `NO_VISIBLE_MESH`, `BONE_MATRIX_NAN`, `SKINNED_MESH_UNBOUND`, and `MISSING_SKIN_ATTRIBUTES` (when SkinnedMeshes are present) now block; Bannon and Maime pass the gate and enter the pipeline normally
- Rewrote `useInputBuffer` hook with a snapshot-based API (`push(snapshot)` / `drain() → BufferedFrame[]`) matching how `MobileControls` actually calls it; eliminates `buffer.drain is not a function` and `buffer.push is not a function` runtime TypeErrors
- Both fixes are universal — no character-specific exceptions added; the pipeline still FAIL CLOSEs on genuinely corrupt assets (no visible mesh, NaN bone matrices, unbound SkinnedMesh)"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/89e69d229a30c03b2327dcd982bfd9a94585d2e2","sha":"89e69d229a30c03b2327dcd982bfd9a94585d2e2"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T15:58:11Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T15:58:11Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T15:58:07.838Z
- Created `src/config/characterNormalization.json` — per-character override layer for all 24 roster members covering `uniformScale`, `yOffset`, `rotationY`, `forwardAxisOverride`, `expectedBounds`, `frustumCulled`, and `blocked`/`blockReason`; includes a `_overrideSchema` reference block so agents know exactly what each field does without reading code
- Created `scripts/normalize-glb.mjs` — Node.js build-time script using `@gltf-transform/core` + `NodeIO` that reads source GLBs, zeros root-node translation to `[0,0,0]`, zeros rotation to identity quaternion, auto-computes uniform scale from AABB height to 1.85 units (or uses `uniformScale` override), applies `yOffset`/`rotationY` overrides from the JSON config, validates against `expectedBounds`, and writes normalized GLBs; supports `--input`, `--output`, `--character`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose` flags
- Added `glb:normalize` and `glb:normalize:dry` npm scripts to `package.json`; `@gltf-transform/core` was already present so no new dependency needed"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/74eb9fae6e051e4c8a7edb0cb0b2e36170d3f587","sha":"74eb9fae6e051e4c8a7edb0cb0b2e36170d3f587"},{"commit":{"author":{"date":"2026-09-16T15:47:47Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"committer":{"date":"2026-09-16T15:47:47Z","email":"example@example.com","name":"Rocket-User"},"message":"Local Commit: 2026-09-16T15:47:44.055Z
- Created `src/engine/pipeline/CharacterPipeline.ts` — the single authoritative character-ingestion pipeline shared by both Character Select and Combat: `SkeletonUtils.clone()` → pre-clone asset validation (FAIL CLOSED) → frustum culling disabled → skin weights normalized → Box3 floor normalization (outer instance only, bones untouched) → geometry-centroid-only forward detection → AnimationMixer on cloned scene → name-based clip binding; returns `null` (BLOCKED) for malformed assets, never secretly re-rigs
- Removed the banned **pose-based forward-axis heuristic** (head Z vs hips Z bone comparison) from both `FighterMesh.tsx` and `CharacterPortrait3D.tsx`; both now delegate to `CharacterPipeline.determineForwardCorrection()` which uses geometry centroid only
- Removed the **synthetic rig fallback** (`AutoRigDetector.buildSyntheticRig`) from `FighterMesh.normalizeGLB()` — bone-less characters now return `BLOCKED` with `PIPELINE_VALIDATION_FAILED` and fire `onDeformationBlocked` instead of being secretly re-rigged; `normalizeGLB` is now a thin wrapper over `runCharacterPipeline`"},"html_url":"https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist/commit/8b8dd180f67f169e28c224b16d0dfa459ab58078","sha":"8b8dd180f67f169e28c224b16d0dfa459ab58078"}]
